title: Firebot Web V2.1 Contracts (DRAFT.2, NOT FROZEN)
description: contract_version=2.1.0-draft.2. Platform-level contracts for R002 Web V2.1. Not a replacement of Canonical MQTT 1.3 (firebot-message-1.3.schema.json); see docs/技术合同/web-v2.1/R002_*_CONTRACT.md for wire mapping. Parsers MUST reject NaN/Infinity literals (RFC 8259) before schema validation.

yaw.description: radians, frame map, 0=+X, CCW positive (地图坐标合同.md). Wire 1.3 name: theta.

quality.description: LIVE/STALE carry a value + observed_at; the others MUST carry value=null (never 0). Maps to web DataSupportState CONNECTED/STALE/NOT_CONNECTED/ERROR/UNSUPPORTED; UNKNOWN = no observation yet.

smokeReading.description: 烟雾单位未经车端/传感器文档证实前禁止标 ppm。unit_verified=false 时 unit 必须是 UNVERIFIED，Web 只能显示原始值+“单位待验证”，不得套用 300ppm 阈值。

envBinding.description: SIM/REAL hard isolation: SIM vehicles live only in the firebot-sim-* namespace; REAL vehicles never do.

allowed.description: Server decision incl. permission. Web MUST NOT recompute.

temperature_c.description: G3-R2: 独立温度已禁用；未接入时 quality=UNSUPPORTED,value=null。

centerline.description: ordered = travel direction; lane is on the right of travel

traversability.description: 无真实规划验证证据时必须 PENDING_VERIFICATION，禁止默认 VERIFIED

execution_gen.description: execution generation; +1 on every resume/re-dispatch of the same mission

goal_id.description: vehicle-side nav goal id (move_base goal id); ingress external_goal_id

control_mode.description: 自动防火罩作业本期暂缓

load_id.description: one load operation; receipt MUST echo it
